title: Hasty Pack
description: This is a full recompilation/remake of my original modpack started in 2022. This features a suite of optimization mods, full Xaero’s Map experience, popular QoL features, partial Bedrock-Java continuity, and more.
body:
**!!!I DO NOT OWN ANY OF THE MODS FEATURED IN THIS PACK!!!**

**Summary**
Hasty Pack is a minecraft modpack intended to solve _most_ of the isues regarding Minecraft Java edtion. Hasty Pack adds Bedrock Java parity, Better Open GL related optimizations, Dynamic Lighting, Mini Maps, and More. The pack is almost entirely client-side  with all server-side mods not interfearing with servers useing Mojangs offical server reasources and guides. If you have any issues or bugs with the pack please reach out to my on Discord (JusitnMPC).
